name: API Call
description: An API call — also called a service-to-service request, REST/gRPC/GraphQL call, API request/response, or backend integration traffic — programmatic request/response traffic between services or to external APIs. Carries authorization context and payloads between processes. The place to look for API traffic, REST/gRPC/GraphQL calls, service-to-service requests, or programmatic request/response between components.
